notes: The report counted 132 probes; 128 survived the copy. The rest are absent here, not passing.
SDK versions are sonde's exact pins at this build (its package.json); the markdown report does not carry them.

host.system.container.title: Host container detection
host.system.container.detail: Running inside the Polkadot host container.

host.system.version.title: App version — is one exposed at all?
host.system.version.detail: No host API returns an app version. Reports from different builds cannot be attributed to those builds, which is the single largest gap in making these results comparable.

host.system.createApp.title: createApp — construct the SDK App
host.system.createApp.detail: App constructed on the configured environment.

host.system.navigateTo.title: navigateTo
host.system.navigateTo.retracted: Skipped because sonde navigated to its own URL, and an honoured navigation to the page's own URL reloads it. That is the host doing what it was asked. Fixed in sonde on 2026-09-19: it opens an outside URL.

host.localStorage.roundTrip.title: Host local storage — string, JSON, bytes

host.chain.genesis.title: Chain spec — genesis, name, properties
host.chain.genesis.detail: Never settled after 45s. A call that neither resolves nor rejects is worse than one that fails.
host.chain.genesis.retracted: sonde's host.chain.genesis asked first for a genesis hash that exists on no chain (it shared only its first seven hex digits with Paseo Asset Hub's), and the host never answered for it. Fixed in sonde on 2026-09-19: real hashes, each with its own deadline.

host.chain.provider.title: Host JSON-RPC provider
host.chain.provider.detail: Needs "host.chain.genesis", which came back timeout. Running anyway would test a placeholder.
host.chain.provider.retracted: Not measured: skipped because host.chain.genesis failed, which was a probe bug.

host.payment.balance.title: Payment — balance subscription (read-only)
host.payment.balance.detail: Subscribed but no balance arrived in 3 s — not even a zero.
host.payment.balance.evidence: A Product cannot show a balance, or decide whether it can afford anything.

host.preimage.lookup.title: Preimage lookup (read-only)
host.preimage.lookup.detail: Lookup never called back in 5 s — neither a hit nor a miss.
host.preimage.lookup.evidence: Calling code cannot distinguish 'still looking' from 'never will'.

host.account.productAccounts.title: Per-index product account derivation
host.account.productAccounts.detail: 4 distinct key(s) across indices — per-index accounts are derivable.

host.account.deriveEntropy.title: deriveEntropy — determinism
host.account.deriveEntropy.detail: Deterministic: the same input gives the same entropy.

host.account.eip712.title: EIP-712 with an app-local burner key
host.account.eip712.detail: Signed and recovered in 3 ms — a contract's ecrecover would accept this.

host.account.anonymousAlias.title: Ring VRF anonymous alias
host.account.anonymousAlias.detail: getAnonymousAlias() returned null — no alias in this runtime.

host.cloud.read.title: Cloud storage read (no signature needed)
host.cloud.read.retracted: sonde read a SHA-256 (bafybei…) CID. The host's lookup finds BLAKE2b-256 content only (almanac P7, 2026-09-14), so the read could never succeed. Fixed in sonde on 2026-09-19: it reads a BLAKE2b-256 fixture.

host.cloud.seal.title: Seal under a crypto-shred key (WebCrypto)
host.cloud.seal.detail: Sealed a placeholder in 0 ms (run the camera probe first for a real payload).

host.cloud.allowance.title: Request a Bulletin allowance
host.cloud.allowance.detail: Allocated, and the App was rebuilt so cloud storage picks up the slot account.

host.cloud.upload.title: Cloud storage upload (canary, then payload)
host.cloud.upload.detail: No genesis hash resolved yet — run host.chain.genesis first. Spending on an unidentified chain is refused.
host.cloud.upload.retracted: Not measured: refused because no genesis resolved (the host.chain.genesis probe bug) and, separately, sonde's spend allowlist was empty. Both fixed in sonde on 2026-09-19.

host.cloud.roundTrip.title: Fetch → CID verify → decrypt
host.cloud.roundTrip.detail: Needs "host.cloud.upload", which came back skip. Running anyway would test a placeholder.
host.cloud.roundTrip.retracted: Not measured: needs host.cloud.upload, which was not run.

host.statement.submit.title: Statement Store — submit
host.statement.submit.detail: No genesis hash resolved yet — run host.chain.genesis first. Spending on an unidentified chain is refused.
host.statement.submit.retracted: Not measured: refused because no genesis resolved (the host.chain.genesis probe bug) and sonde's spend allowlist was empty. Both fixed in sonde on 2026-09-19.

host.permissions.location.title: requestDevicePermission("Location")
host.permissions.location.detail: Host granted Location. Web geolocation immediately after: still failed — User denied Geolocation

web.storage.cookies.title: Cookies + Cookie Store API
web.storage.cookies.detail: A first-party cookie did not persist. In a framed context this is partitioning or third-party cookie blocking, not a broken engine.
web.storage.cookies.evidence:
navigator.cookieEnabled: true
document.cookie write : did not persist
cookieStore API       : present
cookieStore.getAll    : 0 cookie(s)
hasStorageAccess      : true
framed                : false

web.net.csp.title: Content Security Policy in force
web.net.csp.detail: No CSP meta tag; any policy is header-delivered and unreadable from script.

web.net.fetch.title: fetch — same-origin, CORS, streaming
web.net.fetch.detail: Same-origin, cross-origin, and streaming all work.

web.net.beacon.title: sendBeacon
web.net.beacon.detail: sendBeacon returned false — the request was refused, most likely by CSP connect-src.
